Control settings for nbreg()

Source: R/control.R
nbreg_control.Rd

Collects and checks the tolerances, iteration limits and other settings used by nbreg(). Every argument is validated, and an invalid value stops with an error of class nbzinbreg_error_input that names the argument.

Usage

nbreg_control(
  tol = 1e-08,
  maxit = 100,
  trace = FALSE,
  irls_tol = 1e-10,
  irls_maxit = 50,
  theta_tol = 1e-10,
  theta_maxit = 50,
  theta_start = NULL,
  theta_min = 1e-08,
  theta_max = 1e+08,
  theta_warn = 10000,
  max_halving = 30
)

Arguments

tol

Convergence tolerance for the outer loop (one IRLS stage plus one Newton-Raphson stage per pass). The fit has converged when the relative change in the log-likelihood, abs(new - old) / (abs(old) + 0.1), is below tol and the changes in the coefficients and in log(theta) between passes are below sqrt(tol).

maxit

Maximum number of outer passes. Reaching it gives a warning and converged = FALSE.

trace

Logical; if TRUE, print one line of progress per pass.

irls_tol

Tolerance for the IRLS stage (with theta held fixed): it stops when the relative change in the log-likelihood is below irls_tol and the relative change in the coefficients is below sqrt(irls_tol).

irls_maxit

Maximum number of rounds in one IRLS stage.

theta_tol

Tolerance for the Newton-Raphson stage: it stops when the step in log(theta) is smaller than theta_tol.

theta_maxit

Maximum number of rounds in one Newton-Raphson stage.

theta_start

Optional starting value for theta. By default a moment-type estimate from an initial Poisson fit is used.

theta_min, theta_max

Bounds for theta. They constrain the parameter; the likelihood itself is never altered. A fit that ends on a bound is reported with a warning.

theta_warn

Estimates of theta above this value trigger a warning that the data show little or no overdispersion (a Poisson model may be adequate). Must satisfy theta_min < theta_warn <= theta_max.

max_halving

Maximum number of times a step is halved (backtracking) when it would lower the log-likelihood or lead to invalid values.

Value

A list of class nbreg_control holding the validated settings.

Provisional

tol, maxit and trace are part of the required interface. The other arguments are provisional and may change in later versions.

See also

nbreg(), zinbreg_control()

Examples

nbreg_control()

#> [1] 1e-08
#> 
#> $maxit
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $trace
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $irls_tol
#> [1] 1e-10
#> 
#> $irls_maxit
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $theta_tol
#> [1] 1e-10
#> 
#> $theta_maxit
#> [1] 50
#> 
#> $theta_start
#> NULL
#>

#> 
#> $theta_max

#>

#> 
#> $max_halving
#> [1] 30
